💳 Payments and penalties:
Our system provides safe and convenient payment options.

💰 Payment methods:
- Card payment
- Cash payment

⚠️ No-show:
- 1 time: warning
- 2+ times: penalty or mandatory card payment

📌 Goal: fair usage of stadiums
cancel: ⏰ Booking Cancellation Rules ✅ You can cancel a booking no later than 2 hours before it starts. If less than 2 hours remain, cancellation is not possible. 💳 For paid bookings: Depending on when you cancel, part of the paid amount is retained as compensation (since the stadium owner can no longer offer that time slot to another customer): ▫️ 24 hours or more before start: 0% retained — fully refunded ▫️ Between 6–24 hours: approximately 10–30% retained ▫️ Between 2–6 hours: approximately 30–40% retained 📊 The exact percentage is calculated automatically based on how much time remains before the booking starts — you'll see the exact amount before cancelling, and only then confirm. 🔁 Unpaid bookings can be cancelled with nothing retained, since no payment was made. 💰 The refunded amount will reach your card within a few minutes to a few hours. 📌 These rules apply equally to all users of the system and protect the interests of stadium owners.
